newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower in OTC trade. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower in OTC trade. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin for Tuesday, October 29.
* Of seven active issues five were down and two were flat.
* Volume down to 846 shares, turnover also halved at 44,001 German marks (corrects from 44.0 million German marks).
* 10-stock VIN index dropped from 8.703 to 8.613 points.
* Biggest looser was hotelier Istraturist, 9.1 percent down to 50 marks, with 64 shares sold.
* The most actively traded issue was electronic firm Ericsson Tesla, selling 424 shares two percent down to 50 marks.
